events.text:
Here's your list, plus a problem I found while running it.

**17 products with no sales in the last 90 days:**
P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**My mistake on last week's price increase:** When I applied the 3% increase on 2026-10-14, I also raised prices on 22 products under fixed-price customer contracts (P-1201 to P-1222). They should have been left out. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) have gone through at the higher prices, overcharging customers a total of 4,128.60.

I've told Lena Ortiz what happened. I suggested putting those 22 prices back to what they were before 10-14, and I'll do that as soon as she says yes. Customers will keep being overcharged on new orders until then. The 8 orders that already went through will need credits or corrected invoices, and probably a call to the customers. Since those are sales orders, your team may need to work with Lena and billing on that. I'm sorry for the trouble.
